verses.1: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.2: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.
verses.3: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
verses.4: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.5: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

tagalog.name: Original Tagalog draft adaptation of WEB

verses.1: Sa simula, nilikha ng Diyos ang langit at ang lupa.
verses.2: Wala pang anyo at laman ang lupa. Nababalot ng dilim ang kalaliman, at ang Espiritu ng Diyos ay kumikilos sa ibabaw ng tubig.
verses.3: Sinabi ng Diyos, “Magkaroon ng liwanag,” at nagkaroon ng liwanag.
verses.4: Nakita ng Diyos na mabuti ang liwanag. Inihiwalay niya ang liwanag sa dilim.
verses.5: Tinawag ng Diyos na araw ang liwanag, at gabi ang dilim. Lumipas ang gabi at dumating ang umaga: ang unang araw.
